case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We appreciate your prompt reply and deeply value our long-standing, reliable cooperation.
However, your proposed prices are unfortunately far below a feasible level for our production and cannot be accommodated.
In exchange for the 24-month contract term you suggested, we are prepared to offer a revised price of €52.10 per unit.
Alternatively, with valid from 1 December 2026: €52.10 per unit.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We value the reliable cooperation over the past years just as much as you do. Our family foundry has always stood for trust and quality, and we deeply cherish our long-standing partnership with your company. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our offer stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

To demonstrate our commitment to our shared future, we are prepared to step down to €51.20 per unit for the 24-month contract starting 1 December 2026. As an alternative option, we can offer a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your continued movement and the value you place on our reliable cooperation over all these years. In response to your revised offer, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.60 per unit for the 24-month contract starting 1 December 2026. This represents a significant concession on our part to reach an agreement that works for both sides. 

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). We ask you to please decide on these terms. For complete clarity, our offer includes a price of €50.60 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and is valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
